title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
content: The firm previously estimated it handled 4% of global crypto exchange trading volume and raised $17 million after the FTX collapse.

title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
content: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

title: Nvidia shipment freeze and U.S. chip curbs put AI stocks under pressure
content: U.S. export controls have halted Nvidia server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries and put billions in data centre financing under review.

title: New York Attorney General wins $1.4 billion ruling against founders of crypto trading firm NovaTech
content: AWS Mining and NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddie Petion were ordered to pay $1.37 billion after defrauding hundreds of thousands of people, including 11,000 New Yorkers.

title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
content: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach: Report
content: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.

title: Bitcoin price eyes $61K as Talos warns of thin Thanksgiving liquidity
content: Bitcoin joined US stock futures in a modest relief rally as Talos questioned crypto demand and the broader outlook for the AI trade.

title: Zcash devs urge users to migrate 2% of ZEC supply to accelerate Sapling pool retirement
content: Zcash developers urged users to move funds out of an older shielded transaction pool over concerns that AI advances could compromise its cryptography.

title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
content: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
content: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.

title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
content: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

title: New York Wins $1.37B Judgment Against NovaTech Founders Who Fled the US
content: The couple fled the U.S. before a default ruling in 2025, so victims of the scheme may struggle to recover their money.

title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
content: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

title: What Happened to Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia’s Scandal?
content: U.S. intelligence found no evidence that Beijing directed Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, but the former Megaspeed executive still faces entry bans and scrutiny of business ties.

title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
content: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Clears House Committee, Heads to Floor Rep. title: Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028
content: Bitcoin Magazine Switzerland Picks 57 Countries for Crypto Tax Data Sharing Starting in 2028 Switzerland approved 57 partner jurisdictions, including all EU states and the UK, for automatic crypto tax data exchanges under the OECD's CARF from 2028.
